verdict.rationale: Granola Chat can query across all meetings, a folder, or a single meeting using notes or transcripts (granola-docs-63, granola-docs-19), and its official MCP server lets connected AI tools search notes and transcripts for past topics (granola-docs-35, granola-docs-42). The magnifying glass beside each AI-enhanced note shows where in the transcript or raw notes it came from (granola-docs-27), but nothing shows search results linking to the exact moment something was said. Missing for 10: a documented native keyword/full-text search across meetings, jump-to-moment navigation (timestamps or audio playback) from search or chat results, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
